notes: Model is formatted as a wooden raised garden bed rather than an open-ground tilled dirt patch
Footprint is nearly square rather than 2:1 rectangular

blind.description: A stylized square wooden raised garden bed filled with dark soil and four rows of planted crops. The crops include round cabbages, leafy greens/lettuces, and root vegetables (turnips or radishes) with purple-and-white rounded bulb tops poking out of the soil topped with green foliage. The model has clean, solid, slightly beveled stylized geometry with smooth continuous surfaces and no floating or detached elements.
blind.from_above: A square garden planter box containing four horizontal rows of crops planted in rich brown soil: a top row of four turnips/radishes, a second row of four open leafy green lettuces, a third row of four dense round cabbage heads, and a bottom row of five small turnips/radishes.
blind.height_vs_figure: Very low, roughly 1 to 1.5 feet tall (about 1/5 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), while the bed is roughly 7 to 8 feet wide and long (spanning about 1.5 grid squares across).
